subject: Commitment & Onboarding: MAP, Eval Gates, and Billing Contacts
messages:
From: Sofia Rivera <sofia.rivera@greenfield.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@greenfield.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding request: MAP + evaluation gates for AWS Marketplace private offer

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the conversation last week — Greenfield is ready to put a private offer on AWS Marketplace and we want to lock down a mutual action plan so legal/procurement and engineering are aligned. High-level asks from our side:

- A clear MAP with milestones for evaluation, security/compliance checks, procurement approvals, and private-offer creation on AWS Marketplace.
- A recommended evaluation plan (duration, acceptance criteria, who signs off).
- Billing path: we need to understand whether Redwood or AWS invoices Greenfield, and timing for invoice/CAPEX vs OPEX flow.
- Any paperwork or vendor forms Redwood needs from us (W-9, PO template, tax info).

We attached a one-page draft of the MAP (Greenfield_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our W-9. Target close: were hoping to have a signed PO and private-offer purchase within 6 weeks (by the end of July) to coincide with our Q3 budget cycle.

Would you propose a staged timeline and confirm your billing contact and legal reviewer? Also, who from Redwood should our procurement loop in for DocuSign and invoices?

Best,
Sofia Rivera
Head of Procurement
Greenfield Analytics
[Attachment: Greenfield_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Greenfield_W9.pdf (pdf)]

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Rivera <sofia.rivera@greenfield.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@greenfield.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: MAP + evaluation gates for AWS Marketplace private offer

Sofia — great to hear and thanks for the draft MAP. Looping in Priyom (Solutions / Onboarding) to scope the eval cadence and billing ops.

Quick proposal below; I kept milestones tight to hit your ~6-week target but left room for security review. If AWS Marketplace private offer is confirmed, well coordinate with AWS to generate the offer once legal and procurement sign the PO.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high-level):
1) Evaluation kickoff (Week 0):
   - Redwood demo + integration checklist (30-60 minutes)
   - Deliverable: integration runbook + sample prompts/traffic profile
   - Owner: Priyom (technical)
2) Security & Compliance review (Week 1-2):
   - Provide SOC2 artifact summary, data flow diagram, and retention policy.
   - Deliverable: security signoff or open-action list
   - Owner: Redwood Security (I will introduce contact if needed)
3) Commercial/Legal review (Week 2-3):
   - Exchange standard SOW/PO terms; we can use DocuSign for signature.
   - Deliverable: signed PO + private-offer request submitted to AWS
4) Marketplace private-offer creation + procurement (Week 3-4):
   - AWS creates private offer once Redwood/AWS onboarding is complete.
   - Deliverable: private offer link + purchase instructions
5) Billing & Invoicing ramp (Week 4-6):
   - Clarify invoice recipient: Redwood typically invoices the customer directly for Private Offers (monthly billing). For AWS Marketplace purchases where AWS handles procurement, invoice routing can follow AWS terms.
   - Deliverable: billing contact, tax forms (W-9), invoice cadence

Timeline (example to meet 6-week close):
- Jun 14: Kickoff call + finalize MAP scope
- Jun 21: Security/compliance artifacts exchanged
- Jun 28: Legal/PO agreed and DocuSigned
- Jul 5: AWS private offer generated
- Jul 12-20: Purchase complete and first invoice issued

Attachments Im sending: redwood-sla-draft.pdf (draft SLA we typically use) and a one-page MAP template from our side. Please review and mark edits directly on the Drive link Ill share after you confirm.

Action items for Greenfield:
- Confirm cloud provider (AWS vs GCP) 
- Confirm procurement billing address + AP contact + tax info
- Indicate any non-standard contract terms (e.g., data residency or custom retention)

If it helps, I can put together a short mutual action checklist with owners and dates later today. Which time works for a 30-minute kickoff? Im free tomorrow 10:00-11:30 PT or Wednesday 2:00-4:00 PT.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-sla-draft.pdf (pdf)]
